title: I built a tool to automatically execute Telegram trading signals — looking for feedback
author: Glittering_Pass8656
selftext:
I've been following Thomas Kralow's trading community for a while, and one problem I kept having was execution.

A signal comes in on Telegram, then you need to open the exchange, calculate the position size, set the stop loss, add multiple take profits, etc.

Sometimes by the time everything is ready, the price has already moved.

So as a side project I started building **SignalToOrder**.

The idea is pretty simple:

Telegram signal → automatically recognize the setup → calculate position size based on your risk → create the order on the exchange → manage SL and multiple TPs.

Right now I'm testing it with EVEDEX.

The system can recognize things like:

* Symbol
* Long / Short
* Entry range
* Stop Loss
* Multiple Take Profits
* Risk % per trade

It also has a dashboard where you can see orders and performance.

I'm not selling signals and I'm not affiliated with Thomas Kralow or EVEDEX. The tool simply automates the execution of signals that the user already has access to.

I'm currently looking for a few people who already trade Telegram signals to test it and give me real feedback.

Would something like this actually be useful for you?

Website: [https://signaltoorder.app/](https://signaltoorder.app/)
